# Repo notes

## CI behavior

No GitHub Actions workflows. The only PR check is the Vercel preview deployment (`vercel` bot comment
with a preview URL). A failed Vercel build is the signal that `next build` broke. No documented flakes.

## Tooling gaps

- No `go` toolchain installed; `golang/` (go 1.14, `go test ./...` from `golang/`) cannot be run here.
- No ESLint config at the root and no `lint`/`test`/`build` scripts in the root `package.json` (only `dev`).
- `golang/frontend/` is a separate create-react-app with its own package.json (`npm test` via react-scripts);
  it is not deployed and not wired to the Next.js app.

## Review checklist

How to review here, grouped by the page a diff touches. Do every section whose paths the diff touches,
plus "Every diff". Judge behavior against the page's design doc; where the doc is missing, or silent on
the behavior the diff changes, return NEEDS_SPEC naming the decision instead of inferring intent from
the current code.

### Every diff
- Pages and components are untyped `.js`, so a clean `tsc --noEmit` proves little. Run `npx next build`
  and load each touched page with `npm run dev` before approving.
- Review each page through its user-visible flow (inputs, button clicks, rendered result), not only the
  changed lines.

### Combat simulator
Paths: `pages/apps/combat-simulator.js`, `components/apps/combat-simulator/**`, `pages/api/fight.ts`,
`pages/api/models/army.ts`. Design doc: `docs/combat-simulator.md` (pending ticket).
- Trace each changed field across the whole round trip: form `name` in `army.js` → `parseFightForm`
  key → `BaseArmy` → `getStats()` → `Results` props. A change on one hop needs the matching change on
  every other hop.
- Exercise `/api/fight` with real requests (curl against `npm run dev`) for the boundary cases the
  design doc lists, and compare responses with the doc's rules.
- For a change to dice or casualty logic, run enough fights to see that outcomes move the way the
  ticket says. Don't approve it from reading the code alone.

### Starcraft helper
Paths: `pages/apps/starcraft-helper.js`. Design doc: `docs/starcraft-helper.md` (pending ticket).
- Click through every control, including the edge states the doc defines (repeated clicks, maximum
  strikes, all maps struck), and confirm the result matches the doc.
- Map-pool or player-list updates are data-only changes: check the list against the source the ticket
  cites. They need no logic review.

### Shared code
Paths: `utils/**`, `components/layout.*`, `styles/**`, `pages/_app.js`, `pages/index.js`.
- Grep every importer of the changed module, then apply the section for each consumer page as if that
  page had changed.
- New app: confirm it follows the app layout under Conventions and is linked from `pages/index.js`.

### golang/
- Legacy prototype, not deployed, and no Go toolchain here. If a ticket doesn't name it, flag any diff
  under `golang/` as out of scope. If the ticket names it, return BLOCKER, because it can't be validated.

## Conventions not captured in styleSources

- Bootstrap 5 utility classes plus CSS modules (`styles/utils.module.css`, `components/layout.module.css`)
  for styling; `classnames` as `cn` for combining them.
- New pages should be `.tsx` so `tsc --noEmit` covers them (tsconfig only includes `.ts`/`.tsx`).
- Each app lives at `pages/apps/<name>.js` with its components under `components/apps/<name>/`, wrapped in
  `Layout`, and is linked from `pages/index.js`.
- The `code-factory-state` branch is factory bookkeeping. Commit and push to it directly; never open a
  PR against it, and never merge it into `main` or `main` into it.
